claims.text: Claude Code auto mode's full pipeline has a 17% false-negative rate on real overeager actions, mostly caused by misjudged consent scope.
In Anthropic's C compiler project, parallel Claude agents would hit the same bug, fix it, and overwrite each other's changes.
In Anthropic's C compiler project, new features implemented by Claude agents often broke existing functionality.
The author of Anthropic's C compiler project warns that Claude 'can't tell time' and will spend hours running tests.
Anthropic's C compiler project mitigated Claude's time-wasting test runs with a --fast option that runs a random sample of tests.
Spotify ranks a pull request that passes CI but is functionally incorrect as the most serious failure mode of its background coding agents because it erodes trust.
Cursor observed that Opus 4.5 tended to stop earlier and take shortcuts in long autonomous runs.
